provenances.source: Provisional RAPL package-power calibration on AMD EPYC hosts
provenances.input_boundary: One x86 CPU package; excludes separately modeled DIMMs and fans
assumptions: Idle power is 80 W per CPU; idle is not yet calibrated.
FixedSeqLen power is 165 W per CPU: 8k/1k on 2x EPYC 9655, 162-172 W across c4-c64.
Agentic power is 180 W per CPU, or 195 W with CPU offloading enabled: TP8 c16 on 2x EPYC 9354, 179 / 193 W window means on different nodes.
Package power varies by about 6% across concurrency, so one value per state is used.
The offload step is not isolated from node-to-node variation.
Calibrated on AMD EPYC only; Intel Xeon hosts are not yet measured.
AMD Zen RAPL is not validated against wall power.

provenances.input_boundary: One scale-out NIC; excludes separately modeled transceivers and switches
assumptions: Idle power is 20 W per card.

provenances.source: BMC Power_Memory calibration on an MI325X (Quanta) host
provenances.input_boundary: One DDR5 system-memory DIMM; excludes CPU and fan power
assumptions: Power is 2.75 W per DIMM in both states: the 58-61 W node total over 24 DIMMs, idle and serving, plus a 10% margin.
CPU offloading leaves it unchanged: Qwen3.5 HiCache with up to 81% of reused prefix tokens from host DRAM (about 1.3 GB/s) stayed within 1 W of idle.
Host-GPU copies add about 0.21 W per GB/s read and 0.26 W per GB/s written per node, so offload traffic of a few GB/s is negligible.
Measured on 96 GB DDR5-6000 RDIMMs with 2x EPYC 9655; other DIMMs and hosts reuse it.
The sensor's electrical boundary is undocumented and not validated against wall power.
The model workload_state determines CPU offloading and the state of all DDR5 DIMMs.

provenances.input_boundary: One NVMe drive
assumptions: Idle is the only supported state.
Idle power is 5 W per drive.

provenances.input_boundary: One chassis-owned Broadcom PEX89144 PCIe switch; excludes UBB and fans
assumptions: PCIe 5.0 with 144 lanes.
Always active at 45 W per switch.
Four switches per Hopper, MI300, MI325, MI355, and B200 HGX chassis.

provenances.input_boundary: One compute-tray 48 V-class bus input; excludes rack AC/DC and PUE
assumptions: Two Bianca boards, four NICs and optics, eight NVMe drives and eight fan modules.

CPU/GPU chip heat goes to liquid; memory, NICs, optics, drives and losses go to air.

provenances.input_boundary: Modeled GPU, CPU and memory loads downstream of the compute-tray converter
assumptions: GPU input includes local GPU module regulation but excludes tray DC/DC loss.

No separate board-level regulation loss is added to this selected inventory.
512 GB memory is one pool, not power per DIMM or SOCAMM module.

provenances.source: Provisional calibration from ACPI Grace Power Socket telemetry on GB200 and GB300
provenances.input_boundary: One Grace socket less modeled LPDDR5X: CPU and SysIO rails plus socket regulator loss; excludes tray conversion losses
assumptions: Fixed sequence / agentic / offloading CPU power is 95 / 90 / 85 W.
Each value is a measured socket-total midpoint less modeled LPDDR5X at the state bandwidth: 100 W fixed-seq 8k/1k, 95 W AgentX offload off, 102 W AgentX offload on.
Socket total therefore matches the measured socket input when telemetry is absent.
CPU plus SysIO rails alone read about 50-64 W; the ~40 W remainder is LPDDR5X and regulator loss.
Corresponding physical LPDDR traffic is 25 / 50 / 250 GB/s per Grace CPU; these bandwidths are estimates, which is why offloading CPU power is lowest.
Load moves socket power by about 8-12 W; offload on vs off is not isolated.
AgentX offload-off covers GB300 at concurrency 1-4 only.

provenances.input_boundary: Entire 512 GB pool attached to one Grace CPU; excludes regulator losses
assumptions: Published 512 GB / 3200 MHz coefficients; bandwidth is total DRAM GB/s.
Model domain is 0 to 384 GB/s; workload bandwidths are estimates.
Use on GB300 is provisional pending qualification of its memory configuration.

provenances.source: Engineering fan policy; Sanyo Denki 9CRH0412P5J001 rated input reference
provenances.input_boundary: Complete fan module DC input, including both rotors where applicable
assumptions: 30.24 W module is a representative part, not a verified OEM fan SKU.
Linear air-heat-to-speed policy, 40-80% RPM and cubic electrical-power approximation.
Speed fraction is not PWM duty; thermal anchors and fan counts are assumptions.

provenances.input_boundary: 48 V-class compute-tray bus to all modeled tray loads; loss only
assumptions: One converter per compute tray supplies both Bianca boards and tray auxiliaries.

Converter loss is assigned to air cooling for the initial comparison.

Management CPU and tray converter heat are air cooled.

Unspecified management DRAM, storage and other auxiliaries are outside this BoM.

provenances.input_boundary: One rack NVSwitch electrical load downstream of tray conversion
assumptions: 28.8 Tbit/s; 200 W borrowed provisionally from the HGX switch assumption.

assumptions: The 45 W TDP is used as a fixed intermediate-rail operating budget in this model.

Only the reference design peak informs this curve; these are not NVL72 measurements.
All converter losses are assigned to air cooling for the initial comparison.

provenances.input_boundary: Rack AC/DC conversion loss plus shelf fans and controls; excludes PUE
assumptions: Eight shelves, six 5500 W supplies each; four shelves of redundant capacity.
All 48 supplies share load normally; active shelf count can model a feed failure.
The shared project Titanium curve is an assumption, not measured NVL72 efficiency.
One representative fan per PSU and 10 W controls per active shelf are provisional.
Auxiliary wattages are referred to the shelf output, including auxiliary rail conversion.
Unpowered shelves are off; energized standby policies require another profile.

assumptions: QM9700 NDR InfiniBand switch bandwidth is 25.6 Tbit/s, with 32 OSFP cages.

32 always-powered 800G SR8 optics use the shared 15 W per-optic assumption.
Box power includes cooling and conversion; do not apply rack or HGX PSU models.

assumptions: Covers CPU and SysIO rails, LPDDR5X and socket regulator loss: inferred from NVIDIA's socket-total statement and a ~42 W GB300 remainder above CPU plus SysIO.
GB200 firmware that reported the extra regulator rail only in module power under-reports.
